Do you ever give money to bums? I (almost) NEVER give money to bums because I always assume they're either drug addicts or just hustling people for money. Today I saw one (a bum) on the way to Chick Fil A, which isn't rare. I always see them on the way to Chick Fil A. Their corner is right in front of Chick Fil A. Today I had this really strong feeling to give this guy some money or food or something... So I decided to eat 2 fries and give him the rest along with a 5$ bill. I held the bag and the 5 bucks up for him and as he walked closer to the car I started to feel funny. It was regret mixed with fuck-it. I guess the fuck-it could be better explained as I really hope this fucking guy does something good with the 5 bucks. He had what looked like meth mouth, nasty home made looking tattoos, and scraggly hair. I can only assume he really is just a druggy. I hope he at least ate the fries. I don't really care if he uses my 5 bucks to buy some crack, but I probably won't be giving any more money to homeless people.
Do you ever give money to bums?

Well, first, I don't call them bums. Second, yeah, if they ask, and I have money, I will give them money. I can't assume that everyone has some sort of problem, or will use my miniscule amount of change for the wrong thing. I'm not in a position to judge, anyway. In most cases giving them money is better than not giving them money. If they are hooked on drugs, you can either 'help' them out, and they buy what they need, or they go out, and steal it.

That's a very good point, I didn't think about them stealing in order to get what they need. I just have such a hard time with giving them money. If someone came up to me and asked for spare change or a few bucks I would have no problem with that, but when they lie about what they need the money for, or they become offended when you offer something that isn't money... That pisses me off.

The guy today was more of a pan handler. He had a sign that said Homeless and Hungry. I really hope he ate the fries. I've had a couple of run-ins with mean homeless people so I think those negative experiences have just made me assume the worst.

I know I shouldn't call them bums, but I call them bums in real life so I'm not going to pretty up my post for the sake of being PC. Or would that have pissed him off because he was on a come down or something?

Most likely he threw the food away. Many people poison the homeless, so they don't trust food. His teeth and appearance could have been from many things. Meth is one, but if he could have been so bad off for so long... tooth paste and brush are not as important as food.

5 bucks doesn't buy you much crack, but does buy you a bottle of Boons and two 1 buck burgers.
